answer: Each epoch the census walks the ridge against forgery: file one entry or lose standing. Its quill signs a fresh receipt for 45 credits of work, a 25 fee, a 60 bond. Entries are public: a gale exposes a receipt cited twice, burning the bonds; stale ones burn. Rented receipts name their seller; buying fails. 1,000 identities at 70 each (45+25) cost 70,000 plus 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, pays 25, keeps its bond.
